description: Source code for the CFF (Compact Font Format) driver implementation in the FreeType project, including functions for kerning, glyph loading, font info, and driver interface setup.

methods.name: cff_get_kerning
methods.description: Returns the kerning vector between two glyphs of a font face.

methods.name: cff_glyph_load
methods.description: Loads a glyph into a glyph slot with specified load flags.

methods.name: cff_get_advances
methods.description: Retrieves advance widths/heights for a range of glyphs.

methods.name: cff_get_glyph_name
methods.description: Gets the glyph name for a given glyph index.

methods.name: cff_get_name_index
methods.description: Finds the glyph index for a given glyph name.

methods.name: cff_ps_has_glyph_names
methods.description: Checks if glyph names are available in the font face.

methods.name: cff_ps_get_font_info
methods.description: Retrieves font info such as version, full name, family name, etc.

methods.name: cff_get_ps_name
methods.description: Gets the PostScript name of the font.

methods.name: cff_get_cmap_info
methods.description: Retrieves character map information for a font.

methods.name: cff_get_ros
methods.description: Gets registry, ordering, and supplement info for CID fonts.

methods.name: cff_get_is_cid
methods.description: Checks if the font is CID-keyed.

methods.name: cff_property_set
methods.description: Sets a property for the CFF driver.

methods.name: cff_property_get
methods.description: Gets a property value from the CFF driver.
